SELECT JSONExtractString(fields_json, 'city') AS d0,
       count() AS m0,
       quantile(0.5)(toFloat64(JSONExtractFloat(fields_json, 'price_upx'))) AS m1
FROM upland.events
WHERE event_type = 'property_sale'
  AND timestamp >= toDateTime64({p0:String}, 3, 'UTC')
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime64({p1:String}, 3, 'UTC')
GROUP BY d0
ORDER BY m0 DESC
LIMIT 3
